name: Spreading The Word
overview: Scripture reveals that spreading the Word is a divinely ordained mission, as God appoints His servants even before birth to proclaim His truth to all nations (Jeremiah 1:5). Believers are commanded to boldly preach the gospel universally, making disciples through baptism and teaching (Matthew 28:19; Mark 16:15). This mission is grounded in the unwavering presence of the Lord (Psalms 16:8) and motivated by God’s immense love for the world, demonstrated in the gift of His Son to grant eternal life to all who believe (John 3:16). Despite challenges and opposition foretold (Matthew 24:10), the call to spread the gospel remains steadfast and central to the Christian faith.
